repo_notes.content: Browser-only Battleship (human vs AI) in TypeScript + Vite, deployed to GitHub Pages. Game rules live in src/game (pure, no DOM), UI in src/ui/app.ts, vector SVG warship drawings in src/ui/sprites.ts. The UI shows ONE grid split by a centre line: own zone (data-owner=player) on the left, enemy zone (data-owner=ai) on the right; internally there are still two Board objects (playerBoard, aiBoard). Attack and defence alternate every round. The defender may move one afloat ship (damaged or not) one cell up/down/left/right, or choose 'no move' (移動なし); the move happens first, then the attacker's missile. No timer: the player's attack fires on click. Write for beginners; the UI and docs are in Japanese, so write the wiki in Japanese.

pages.title: ゲームの全体像
pages.purpose: What the game does, how to play (placement, alternating attack/defence rounds with one-cell defensive moves, win/lose, restart), and how the src/game and src/ui layers fit together

pages.title: ゲームのルール処理（Board と Game）
pages.purpose: Explain src/game/board.ts and src/game/game.ts: ship placement, attack results, sinking, phases, turns and winner

pages.title: 船の移動ルール
pages.purpose: Explain canMoveBy / moveBy / legalOffsets / MOVE_STEPS in board.ts and the round flow in game.ts (playerAttack, playerDefend, planTarget, planMove, resolveRound): one-cell moves for any afloat ship, no overlap, hit marks move with the ship, misses under a stopped ship disappear

pages.title: AIの考え方
pages.purpose: Explain the hunt-and-target strategy in src/game/ai.ts, how observe() re-reads the visible marks each round so it follows moved ships and never fires at a marked cell, and the defensive move (chooseEvasion, EVADE_CHANCES)

pages.title: AIの強さ（弱い・普通・強い）
pages.purpose: Explain the Difficulty type and how AiPlayer switches strategy: easy = random untried cell, normal = hunt and target, hard = probability map over remaining ship placements; EVADE_CHANCES per difficulty; Game(random, difficulty) and setDifficulty (placement phase only); the difficulty buttons (data-difficulty, aria-pressed) in src/ui/app.ts

pages.title: 画面（UI）と1枚の盤面
pages.purpose: Explain src/ui/app.ts: the single grid built by buildGrid (own zone left, divider, enemy zone right), data-owner, click handling, the round flow (startRound / showOutcome), the 移動なし button, ship selection with reachable cells, arrow keys, result dialog and restart

pages.title: 船のイラストと見た目
pages.purpose: Explain src/ui/sprites.ts (top-down stealth-warship drawings in vector SVG, orientTransform for vertical / enemy ships, per-cell viewBox slices, player / enemy / wreck palettes, hit / miss / missile images) and src/style.css (navy tactical theme, centre divider, side panel, horizontal scroll on narrow screens)

pages.title: 艦隊パネルと通算成績
pages.purpose: Explain renderFleet in src/ui/app.ts (remaining ship count, 健在 / 被弾 / 撃沈 / 未配置 badges and hit cells per ship), src/ui/record.ts (createRecordStore, winRate, localStorage key battleship-record, recorded once per game) and the VICTORY / DEFEAT result screen with attack count, hit rate and ships left

pages.title: ミサイルの弾道演出
pages.purpose: Explain src/ui/missile.ts and missile.css: flightPath (quadratic Bezier arc with heading angle), launchMissile (MISSILE_FLIGHT_MS = 800, glowing trail, overlay on the grid, Web Animations API, incoming lock-on class hiding the result until impact), cancelling on restart, and skipping the missile when prefers-reduced-motion is set. The game rules are resolved instantly; the missile is visual only

pages.title: 効果音
pages.purpose: Explain src/ui/sound.ts: hit and sunk sounds synthesised with the Web Audio API (square wave + noise, no audio files), soundForOutcome, creating the AudioContext on the first sound because of autoplay rules, the 効果音 ON/OFF toggle saved in localStorage, and how tests inject a fake SoundPlayer

pages.title: テストと公開
pages.purpose: Explain the Vitest tests in tests/ (logic tests and jsdom UI tests with fake timers), npm run check, the CI workflow and the GitHub Pages deploy workflow

pages.title: バグと修正の記録
pages.purpose: Summarize every bug in docs/bug-report.md: symptom, cause, fix and regression test

pages.title: 開発の進め方
pages.purpose: Explain AGENTS.md rules, the PR workflow, and that .devin/wiki.json should be updated and the wiki regenerated after a feature is merged
